notes.title: Controller Support and more!
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- Tangrams Deluxe now supports native xinput controller support. If you have a 360 or XBox One controller you can start solving puzzles from the comfort of your own couch.
- Shadow Toggle, if you're having trouble making out the target shape from the shadows of the Tangram pieces you can now toggle them on and off.
- Doodle update, we decided that certain doodles were looking a little old so we've gone and replaced them with brand new fancy ones!
- Language, Urdu has been replaced with Korean.

The in game languages are now as listed:
English, Portuguese PT, Portuguese BR, Tagalog, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Korean.
